name: Lean Default (stronger models only)
server: Any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible server, or a command line
models: Any model strong enough to do a whole job from one look at the page
notes: For a model that needs little telling and is dear to call. It gets a short job description, only the calls a turn may make (not the whole tool list), a typed page as its text with no picture, and gives a job's words or sketch in the plan itself, so most jobs are one call. A weaker model on this harness will plan badly: use Default for those.
